term: unchanged indexed-signal forwarding or local issuance
definition: signal n is the optional numeric code at station n's output; issued n records issuance at that station in this stipulated role. Every present output code j either is issued here with j=n or occurs unchanged at the immediate upstream output n+1. This excludes unaccounted changes or external injections locally, without asserting a global originating node.
note: Analyst closed-channel interface, motivated conditionally by Koons PGR's create-at-own-position or maintain-inherited-particle description, not attributed as his exact formal statement or as established physics. A received code and an issuing act are distinct. Does not ensure every issuance produces an output, a no-input trigger, persistence at other times, truth of a 'first' message, or actual causal power. CPNPP preservation and real-system applicability remain OPEN.
